answer.rationale: Do not counter with deeper promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment increased signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, directly conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Broadly roll out the already-confirmed simplified onboarding for self-serve/SMB accounts; it improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. This does not prove it will fully offset competitor-driven price churn, so retain that uncertainty rather than assuming a complete churn solution.
